nodes.name: CheckpointTrigger
nodes.summary: Enum of checkpoint firing conditions: always, on-concerns, on-fail, or never.

nodes.name: _find_review_verdict
nodes.summary: Scans prior step outputs backwards for the most recent review verdict.

nodes.name: _should_fire
nodes.summary: Decides whether a checkpoint fires by comparing the trigger's severity threshold against the observed verdict.

nodes.name: CheckpointAction
nodes.summary: Action implementation that evaluates the trigger against prior verdicts and returns a pause-or-continue result.

nodes.name: commit.py
nodes.summary: Commit pipeline action that stages configured paths and creates a git commit, appending an iteration suffix to composed messages inside loop steps.

nodes.name: CommitAction
nodes.summary: Action implementation that validates commit config, stages files, composes the message, and invokes git via the shared git_utils runner.

nodes.name: compact.py
nodes.summary: Compact pipeline action that reduces conversation context, delegating to the SDK session's compact() when available and otherwise dispatching /compact and awaiting the compact_boundary system message.
nodes.languageNotes: Two execution paths keyed on whether an sdk_session is present; the prompt-only path awaits SystemMessage(subtype='compact_boundary').

nodes.name: CompactAction
nodes.summary: Action implementation exposing SDK-rotate and prompt-only compaction strategies behind one action type.

nodes.name: gate.py
nodes.summary: Gate pipeline action that reduces a judge verdict and a review verdict into a single verdict, with a pluggable gate-policy registry and declared policy contracts.
nodes.languageNotes: Policy implementations are registered rather than switched on, keeping the action open for extension.

nodes.name: GatePolicy
nodes.summary: Enum of gate decision policies: most-severe reduction and findings-addressed.

nodes.name: GatePolicyContract
nodes.summary: Declares which config keys a policy requires, forbids, and whether it supports a judge block.

nodes.name: policy_contract
nodes.summary: Returns the contract describing the required, forbidden, and judge-related config for a given gate policy.

nodes.name: _Severity
nodes.summary: Internal IntEnum ordering verdicts by severity so two verdicts can be reduced by comparison.

nodes.name: reduce_verdicts
nodes.summary: Reduces two verdicts to the more severe of the pair using the severity ordering.

nodes.name: GatePolicyImplementation
nodes.summary: Protocol every gate policy implementation satisfies, exposing a single evaluate method.

nodes.name: register_gate_policy
nodes.summary: Registers a gate policy implementation against its GatePolicy enum member.

nodes.name: MostSevereGatePolicy
nodes.summary: Gate policy that evaluates the judge and review legs and returns the more severe verdict with its provenance.

nodes.name: GateAction
nodes.summary: Action implementation that validates gate config against the policy contract and delegates evaluation to the registered policy.

nodes.name: protocol.py
nodes.summary: Declares the runtime-checkable Action protocol every pipeline action must satisfy: an action_type identifier, an async execute, and a config validate.

nodes.name: Action
nodes.summary: Protocol interface for pipeline action implementations.

nodes.name: summary.py
nodes.summary: Summary pipeline action that captures a conversation summary via the configured provider profile and fans it out to the configured emit destinations.

nodes.name: SummaryAction
nodes.summary: Action implementation that validates summary config, selects the SDK or one-shot capture path, and supports restoring a previously captured summary.

nodes.name: _execute_summary
nodes.summary: Captures the summary text and dispatches it through each parsed emit destination, collecting per-destination results.

nodes.name: emit.py
nodes.summary: Emit destination registry for the summary action: defines the EmitKind enum, destination/result dataclasses, the built-in stdout/file/clipboard/rotate handlers, and the emit-spec parsers.
nodes.languageNotes: Built-in destinations self-register at import time, so importing the module is what populates the registry.

nodes.name: EmitKind
nodes.summary: Enum of supported emit destination kinds: stdout, file, clipboard, and rotate.

nodes.name: EmitDestination
nodes.summary: Parsed destination pairing an EmitKind with its optional argument, plus a display rendering.

nodes.name: EmitResult
nodes.summary: Per-destination emit outcome carrying the destination, success flag, and detail message.

nodes.name: get_emit
nodes.summary: Resolves the registered emit handler for a destination kind, raising when unregistered.

nodes.name: _emit_file
nodes.summary: Writes summary text to the destination file path, creating parent directories and reporting write failures.

nodes.name: _emit_clipboard
nodes.summary: Copies summary text to the system clipboard, reporting failure when no clipboard mechanism is available.

nodes.name: _emit_rotate
nodes.summary: Rotates the active session by seeding the captured summary into a fresh session.

nodes.name: parse_emit_entry
nodes.summary: Parses one emit spec entry (string or mapping) into a validated EmitDestination.

nodes.name: parse_emit_list
nodes.summary: Parses the raw emit configuration into a list of EmitDestination values, defaulting sensibly and rejecting malformed specs.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Locates the shipped package-data directory (models.toml, templates, pipelines) so runtime lookups work identically in wheel and editable installs.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses importlib.resources with a __file__-relative fallback to survive both wheel and editable installs.

nodes.name: data_dir
nodes.summary: Returns the squadron/data package directory, preferring importlib.resources and falling back to the module's own parent path.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Root of the events package: defines the closed EventType enum and the module-level registry that user-definable event actions register into.
nodes.languageNotes: Closed StrEnum of events plus a module-level dict registry; adding an event is a squadron change, never a user change.

nodes.name: EventType
nodes.summary: Canonical closed set of events (COMMIT, POST_ACTION) that a user action may bind to.

nodes.name: register_event_action
nodes.summary: Registers an EventAction implementation into the global registry, validating its name and declared events.

nodes.name: get_event_action
nodes.summary: Looks up a registered event action by its namespaced name, raising when unknown.

nodes.name: bootstrap_event_actions
nodes.summary: Imports the built-in event action modules so their module-foot registration side effects populate the registry.

nodes.name: artifact_paths.py
nodes.summary: Single shared helper that asks Context Forge for a phase's expected artifact path(s), so the dispatch-artifact and revision-stamp built-ins cannot drift apart.

nodes.name: expected_artifact_paths
nodes.summary: Resolves the expected artifact file path(s) for a given ArtifactKind and slice index via the CF client, propagating resolution failures to the caller.

nodes.name: dispatch_artifact.py
nodes.summary: POST_ACTION built-in that verifies a phase-step dispatch actually wrote its expected artifact during this run, failing the step when the post-condition is unmet.

nodes.name: _check_dispatch_artifact_written
nodes.summary: Checks whether the expected artifact file exists and was modified after the run start timestamp.

nodes.name: _dispatch_artifact_post_condition_error
nodes.summary: Builds the human-readable post-condition failure message describing which artifact was expected and why the check failed.

nodes.name: DispatchArtifactAction
nodes.summary: EventAction implementation bound to POST_ACTION that runs the dispatch artifact post-condition check.

nodes.name: frontmatter_gate.py
nodes.summary: COMMIT built-in that shells out to `cf validate frontmatter` and blocks the commit when frontmatter validity cannot be established.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses asyncio.create_subprocess_exec rather than a blocking subprocess call inside an async function.

nodes.name: FrontmatterGateAction
nodes.summary: EventAction bound to COMMIT that runs the cf frontmatter validator and maps its exit code to pass/fail, treating an indeterminate result as failure.

nodes.name: revision_stamp.py
nodes.summary: POST_ACTION built-in that stamps a monotonic revision_number into the frontmatter of the artifact a loop-iteration dispatch just wrote.
nodes.languageNotes: Never fails by design: every parse/write error is logged at WARNING and swallowed so a stamp failure cannot break a converging loop.

nodes.name: _stamp_revision_number
nodes.summary: Reads the artifact's frontmatter, increments revision_number, and writes it back, logging and swallowing any failure.

nodes.name: RevisionStampAction
nodes.summary: EventAction bound to POST_ACTION that applies the revision stamp to the dispatch's expected artifact.

nodes.name: contexts.py
nodes.summary: Defines the per-event context dataclasses passed to EventAction.execute, deliberately separate from the pipeline ActionContext so each event carries only fields it can honestly provide.

nodes.name: EventContext
nodes.summary: Frozen base context carrying the event type, working directory, and binding params common to every event.

nodes.name: CommitContext
nodes.summary: COMMIT-event context adding the list of staged paths under inspection.

nodes.name: PostActionContext
nodes.summary: POST_ACTION context carrying the completed action's type, result, run/step identity, expected artifact kind, iteration, and CF client.

nodes.name: discovery.py
nodes.summary: Imports the plugin modules declared in the events manifest so they self-register their actions; declared imports only, never filesystem scanning.
nodes.languageNotes: Temporarily prepends cwd to sys.path so in-repo plugins resolve without packaging ceremony, then always removes it.

nodes.name: PluginLoadError
nodes.summary: Exception raised when a declared plugin module fails to import, carrying the module path and originating manifest for attribution.

nodes.name: discover_plugins
nodes.summary: Imports each declared plugin module with cwd temporarily on sys.path, raising PluginLoadError on failure.

nodes.name: dispatcher.py
nodes.summary: The single execution path for firing event bindings: runs each bound action under a timeout and reduces the results, collecting all failures for COMMIT and stopping at the first for POST_ACTION.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses asyncio.wait_for as the timeout mechanism; the one deliberate broad `except Exception` sits at the dispatch boundary and is attributed to the failing action name.

nodes.name: OutcomeErrorKind
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing how a binding failed (raised, timed out, or returned a failing result).

nodes.name: EventOutcome
nodes.summary: Result record pairing an action name with its ActionResult and error kind.

nodes.name: _run_binding
nodes.summary: Executes one binding's action under asyncio.wait_for, converting raises and timeouts into a failed EventOutcome.

nodes.name: fire
nodes.summary: Runs all bindings for an event, applying collect-all semantics for COMMIT and fail-fast semantics for POST_ACTION.

nodes.name: run_event
nodes.summary: Top-level entry point that loads the manifest, resolves bindings, and fires them for the given context.

nodes.name: manifest.py
nodes.summary: Loads and resolves events.yaml into typed Binding/EventManifest structures, searching project then user locations with first-found-wins and merging built-in defaults minus disabled entries.
nodes.languageNotes: First-found-wins resolution with no merge, mirroring pipeline/loader.py's search-dirs idiom.

nodes.name: Binding
nodes.summary: Immutable record of one event-to-action binding with its params and originating source.

nodes.name: EventManifest
nodes.summary: Parsed manifest holding declared plugins, bindings, disabled action names, and the resolved manifest path.

nodes.name: _resolve_manifest_path
nodes.summary: Picks the effective events.yaml path by checking the project location first, then the user config location.

nodes.name: load_manifest
nodes.summary: Reads and validates events.yaml into an EventManifest, raising ManifestError with the source path on any parse or schema failure.

nodes.name: resolve_bindings
nodes.summary: Produces the effective binding list: built-in defaults minus disabled names, followed by manifest bindings in file order.

nodes.name: executor.py
nodes.summary: The pipeline execution engine: merges parameters, resolves placeholders, and runs a PipelineDefinition step by step, handling retry loops, `each`/`fan_out` collection steps, checkpoint pauses, and lazy SDK session connection.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses StrEnum for status/condition vocabularies and dataclasses for result DTOs; the executor is a large module of module-level async coroutines rather than a class, with the step registry injected as callables (get_step_type_fn / get_action_fn) for testability.

nodes.name: _summarize_action_config
nodes.summary: Builds a compact, log-safe summary of an action's configuration for diagnostic output.

nodes.name: _log_action_result
nodes.summary: Emits a structured log record describing the outcome of a completed action.

nodes.name: resolve_placeholders
nodes.summary: Recursively substitutes `{param}` placeholders throughout an action config dict using the merged pipeline parameters.

nodes.name: _resolve_str
nodes.summary: Performs placeholder substitution on a single string value, preserving unmatched tokens rather than failing silently.

nodes.name: evaluate_condition
nodes.summary: Evaluates a loop exit condition (such as a verdict-based LoopCondition) against the accumulated action results of an iteration.

nodes.name: _format_findings_as_instructions
nodes.summary: Renders a list of review findings into remediation instructions to feed back into the next loop iteration.

nodes.name: _prompt_checkpoint_interactive
nodes.summary: Presents an interactive terminal prompt at a checkpoint, letting the operator approve, abort, or supply override instructions, and returns the resulting CheckpointDecision.

nodes.name: _parse_loop_config
nodes.summary: Parses a raw loop YAML block into a typed LoopConfig, validating max iterations, until-condition, exhaust behavior, and strategy.

nodes.name: _cf_unfinished_slices
nodes.summary: Queries the Context Forge client for slices that are not yet complete, used as a collection source for `each` steps.

nodes.name: _parse_source
nodes.summary: Parses an `each` step's source expression (e.g. `cf.unfinished_slices()`) into a registry lookup plus arguments.

nodes.name: execute_pipeline
nodes.summary: Top-level entry point that runs an entire PipelineDefinition: merges params, dispatches each step to the right executor variant, records state callbacks, honors resume/start-from, and returns a PipelineResult.

nodes.name: _step_needs_sdk
nodes.summary: Determines whether a step requires a live SDK session, so the session can be connected lazily only when needed.

nodes.name: _connect_lazy_session
nodes.summary: Establishes the SDK execution session on first use, raising LazySessionConnectError if the connection fails.

nodes.name: _execute_step_once
nodes.summary: Runs a single step exactly once: expands it into actions via its step type, executes each action with a built ActionContext, and propagates failures or checkpoint pauses.

nodes.name: _loop_exhaust_result
nodes.summary: Produces the StepResult for a loop that hit its iteration ceiling, honoring the configured on-exhaust behavior (fail, pause, or continue).

nodes.name: _warn_loop_abandoned_on_pause
nodes.summary: Logs a warning when a loop is abandoned mid-iteration because a checkpoint paused the run.

nodes.name: _resume_start_iteration
nodes.summary: Computes which loop iteration a resumed run should restart from, given the persisted start-from step and iteration.

nodes.name: _degenerate_start_iteration_result
nodes.summary: Returns an explicit result when a resume points past the loop's maximum iteration, rather than silently skipping the step.

nodes.name: _execute_loop_step
nodes.summary: Drives a single-action retry loop: repeats the action until the until-condition is satisfied or the iteration ceiling is reached.

nodes.name: _execute_loop_body
nodes.summary: Executes a multi-step loop body, running every inner step per iteration, feeding findings forward as remediation instructions, and optionally committing each iteration.

nodes.name: _execute_each_step
nodes.summary: Executes an `each` collection step: resolves the source expression to a list of items and runs the inner steps once per item.

nodes.name: _execute_fan_out_step
nodes.summary: Executes a fan-out step, running inner step groups across parallel branches and aggregating their action results back into one StepResult.

nodes.name: LazySessionConnectError
nodes.summary: Exception raised when the lazily-connected SDK execution session fails to establish.

nodes.name: ExecutionStatus
nodes.summary: Enumeration of terminal and intermediate execution states for steps and pipelines (success, failure, paused, and related states).

nodes.name: StepResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass carrying the outcome of one executed step: its name, type, status, action results, iteration index, and any error.

nodes.name: PipelineResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass aggregating the outcome of an entire pipeline run, including per-step results and the step at which the run paused.

nodes.name: LoopCondition
nodes.summary: Enumeration of the supported loop exit conditions evaluated after each iteration.

nodes.name: ExhaustBehavior
nodes.summary: Enumeration describing what a loop should do when it reaches its maximum iteration count without satisfying the exit condition.

nodes.name: LoopConfig
nodes.summary: Typed loop configuration: maximum iterations, until-condition, exhaust behavior, strategy, and per-iteration commit flag.

nodes.name: CheckpointResolution
nodes.summary: Enumeration of the ways an operator can resolve an interactive checkpoint prompt.

nodes.name: CheckpointDecision
nodes.summary: Dataclass pairing a checkpoint resolution with any override instructions the operator supplied.

nodes.name: loader.py
nodes.summary: Loads pipeline YAML definitions from built-in, user, and project directories, validates them through the Pydantic schema plus semantic checks, and discovers available pipelines.

nodes.name: _load_yaml
nodes.summary: Reads and parses a YAML file from disk, raising an explicit error on malformed or non-mapping content.

nodes.name: load_pipeline
nodes.summary: Resolves a pipeline by name or path across the search directories, parses its YAML, and converts it into a validated PipelineDefinition.

nodes.name: _search_dirs
nodes.summary: Builds the ordered list of directories searched for pipeline definitions: project, user, and bundled package data.

nodes.name: discover_pipelines
nodes.summary: Scans all search directories and returns PipelineInfo records for every discoverable pipeline, with project definitions shadowing built-ins.

nodes.name: validate_pipeline
nodes.summary: Runs the full semantic validation sweep over a PipelineDefinition — step types, model aliases, review templates, gate references, and parameter placeholders — returning a list of ValidationErrors.

nodes.name: _validate_model_alias
nodes.summary: Verifies that a model alias referenced by a pipeline or step resolves through the ModelResolver.

nodes.name: _validate_review_template
nodes.summary: Checks that a review step names a template that actually exists in the template registry.

nodes.name: _validate_gate_references
nodes.summary: Ensures a gate step only references prior step names that exist and appear earlier in the pipeline.

nodes.name: _validate_param_placeholders
nodes.summary: Confirms that every `{param}` placeholder used in a step's config corresponds to a declared pipeline parameter.

nodes.name: PipelineInfo
nodes.summary: Lightweight descriptor of a discovered pipeline: name, description, source tier, and file path.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Defines the core plain-dataclass DTOs shared across the pipeline system: ValidationError, ActionResult, ActionContext, StepConfig, and PipelineDefinition.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately Pydantic-free — these are internal DTOs, with heavy dependencies (ModelResolver, SDKExecutionSession, CfClientProtocol) imported under TYPE_CHECKING to avoid import cycles.

nodes.name: ValidationError
nodes.summary: Structured validation failure carrying the offending field, a message, and the action type it came from.

nodes.name: ActionResult
nodes.summary: Uniform result contract returned by every action, carrying success, outputs, error, verdict, findings, score, criteria, and provenance.

nodes.name: ActionContext
nodes.summary: Everything an action needs to execute: pipeline and run identity, merged params, step position, prior outputs, resolver, CF client, cwd, SDK session, and loop iteration state.

nodes.name: StepConfig
nodes.summary: A single pipeline step as loaded from YAML: its step type, optional name, and raw config mapping.

nodes.name: PipelineDefinition
nodes.summary: The fully-loaded pipeline: name, description, declared params, ordered steps, default model, and auth policy.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic v2 schema layer that validates raw pipeline YAML into typed structures and converts them into the PipelineDefinition/StepConfig dataclasses the executor consumes.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Pydantic v2 field_validator and model_validator hooks to unpack the single-key-dict step form and enforce a non-empty step list before conversion to plain dataclasses.

nodes.name: _expand_step_config
nodes.summary: Normalizes a step's raw config, promoting scalar shorthand forms into a full config mapping.

nodes.name: StepSchema
nodes.summary: Pydantic model for a single validated pipeline step (step type, name, config).

nodes.name: PipelineSchema
nodes.summary: Top-level Pydantic model for a pipeline YAML document; validates the auth policy, unpacks the step list, rejects empty pipelines, and converts to a PipelineDefinition.

nodes.name: state.py
nodes.summary: Persists and restores pipeline run state as JSON under the squadron runs directory, using atomic write-then-rename, and supplies the models (RunState, StepState, CheckpointState, CompactSummary) that make resume and pruning possible.
nodes.languageNotes: Atomic write-then-rename guards against corruption on interrupted writes; a schema_version field with SchemaVersionError enforces explicit failure rather than silent misreads of older state files.

nodes.name: ExecutionMode
nodes.summary: Enumeration of the modes a run can execute in, recorded on the persisted run state.

nodes.name: SchemaVersionError
nodes.summary: Raised when a persisted state file carries a schema version this build cannot safely read.

nodes.name: StepState
nodes.summary: Persisted record of one completed step: name, type, status, verdict, score, outputs, action results, iteration, and completion timestamp.

nodes.name: CheckpointState
nodes.summary: Persisted record of why and where a run paused at a checkpoint.

nodes.name: CompactSummary
nodes.summary: A stored context-compaction summary keyed by step, retained so a resumed run can rehydrate condensed history.

nodes.name: RunState
nodes.summary: The full serialized state of a pipeline run — schema version, identity, params, execution mode, status, progress, checkpoint, compact summaries, and pool selections — with a helper to pick the active compact summary for resume.

nodes.name: StateManager
nodes.summary: Owns the run-state lifecycle: initializes runs, produces the executor's step-completion callback, appends step records, logs pool selections and compact summaries, finalizes runs, and supports load, resume-point lookup, listing, matching, and pruning.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel for pipeline step types: exports the StepType protocol and StepTypeName enum, and hosts the step-type registry with a bootstrap that registers every built-in step implementation.
nodes.languageNotes: Bootstrap imports the concrete step modules lazily inside the function to break the circular dependency between the registry and the step implementations that register into it.

nodes.name: get_step_type
nodes.summary: Looks up a registered step-type implementation by name, raising an explicit error for unknown types.

nodes.name: bootstrap_step_types
nodes.summary: Imports and registers all built-in step-type implementations so the registry is populated before a pipeline runs.

nodes.name: register_step_type
nodes.summary: Registers a StepType implementation in the module-level step-type registry under the given type name.

nodes.name: StepTypeName
nodes.summary: StrEnum naming every supported pipeline step type, giving the YAML vocabulary a single authoritative definition.

nodes.name: collection.py
nodes.summary: Defines the `each` step type, which iterates a source collection expression and runs its inner steps once per item.

nodes.name: EachStepType
nodes.summary: Step type that validates an `each` block's source expression and inner steps, exposing them to the executor which handles the actual iteration.

nodes.name: compact.py
nodes.summary: Defines the `compact` step type, which translates a compact config block into a single context-compaction action.

nodes.name: CompactStepType
nodes.summary: Step type that validates a compact block and expands it into one compact action.

nodes.name: devlog.py
nodes.summary: Defines the `devlog` step type, expanding a devlog config into a single devlog action supporting auto and explicit modes.

nodes.name: DevlogStepType
nodes.summary: Step type that validates the devlog mode against the allowed set and expands to a single devlog action.

nodes.name: dispatch.py
nodes.summary: Defines the `dispatch` step type, expanding a dispatch config into a single agent-dispatch action with optional prompt and model overrides.

nodes.name: DispatchStepType
nodes.summary: Step type that expands to one dispatch action; when no prompt is given it falls back to the most recent build_context output, matching phase-step behavior.

nodes.name: gate.py
nodes.summary: Defines the `gate` step type, which reduces referenced prior verdicts under a named gate policy and optionally fires a checkpoint on the result.

nodes.name: GateStepType
nodes.summary: Step type that validates gate reference fields and the optional judge block against the selected policy contract, then expands to a gate action plus an optional checkpoint.

nodes.name: loop.py
nodes.summary: Defines the `loop` step type: a multi-step loop body with configurable retry semantics, whose expand() intentionally returns nothing because the executor drives iteration directly.

nodes.name: LoopStepType
nodes.summary: Step type that performs deep static validation of a loop body — inner step types, gate ordering, findings-addressed gates, verdict counts, and per-iteration commit rules — while delegating actual iteration to the executor.

nodes.name: phase.py
nodes.summary: Defines the `phase` step type, which expands a named project phase into a full sequence of actions (context build, dispatch, review, checkpoint) and declares the artifact kind the dispatch must produce.

nodes.name: ArtifactKind
nodes.summary: StrEnum naming the kinds of artifact a phase step's dispatch is expected to write (design, tasks, and related).

nodes.name: PhaseStepType
nodes.summary: Step type that validates a phase configuration and expands it into the ordered action sequence for that phase, wiring in the expected artifact kind and checkpoint triggers.

nodes.name: protocol.py
nodes.summary: Declares the StepType Protocol that every pipeline step-type implementation must satisfy: expand a StepConfig into action pairs and validate its configuration.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a @runtime_checkable typing.Protocol for structural typing, so step implementations conform by shape without inheriting from a base class.

nodes.name: StepType
nodes.summary: Runtime-checkable Protocol defining the step-type interface: a step_type name, an expand() to action pairs, and a validate() returning ValidationErrors.

nodes.name: review.py
nodes.summary: Defines the `review` step type, expanding a standalone review config into a review action followed by an optional checkpoint.

nodes.name: ReviewStepType
nodes.summary: Step type that validates a review block and expands it into a review action plus an optional checkpoint driven by the review verdict.

nodes.name: summary.py
nodes.summary: Defines the `summary` step type, which generates a run summary and emits it to one or more parsed destinations, optionally followed by a checkpoint.

nodes.name: SummaryStepType
nodes.summary: Step type that validates the emit destination list and expands to a summary action, optionally followed by a checkpoint.

nodes.name: utils.py
nodes.summary: Shared helper for step-type implementations that need to unpack nested YAML step lists into StepConfig objects.

nodes.name: unpack_inner_steps
nodes.summary: Converts a raw YAML list of single-key step dicts into a list of typed StepConfig objects.

nodes.name: summary_context.py
nodes.summary: Pure-function module that assembles prior step results into a prepended context block for non-SDK summary models, which have no session history of their own.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately side-effect free — no I/O, no provider calls — so it can be called from any async context and tested without mocking providers or sessions.

nodes.name: assemble_dispatch_context
nodes.summary: Walks the prior action outputs and builds a formatted context block describing what earlier dispatch and review steps produced.

nodes.name: _extract_content
nodes.summary: Pulls the meaningful textual content out of an ActionResult regardless of which action produced it.

nodes.name: _format_review
nodes.summary: Renders a review ActionResult — verdict, score, and findings — into a readable context fragment.

nodes.name: summary_oneshot.py
nodes.summary: Provides one-shot summary execution for non-SDK provider profiles, mirroring the review one-shot path so summary actions can be routed through any configured provider.

nodes.name: capture_summary_via_profile
nodes.summary: Dispatches summary instructions to a non-SDK provider profile in a single call and returns the captured summary text.

nodes.name: context_forge.py
nodes.summary: Typed client wrapping the Context Forge (`cf`) CLI, centralizing every subprocess call behind one class with dataclass return values.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses frozen-style dataclasses plus custom exception types to give a typed façade over an external CLI.

nodes.name: ContextForgeClient
nodes.summary: Executes `cf` CLI subcommands (project info, slice list, task list, config) and parses their JSON/text output into typed results, raising ContextForgeNotAvailable or ContextForgeError on failure.

nodes.name: SliceEntry
nodes.summary: Dataclass describing one slice returned by `cf`: index, name, design file, and status.

nodes.name: TaskEntry
nodes.summary: Dataclass describing one task group returned by `cf`, holding the task index and its associated files.

nodes.name: ProjectInfo
nodes.summary: Dataclass carrying Context Forge project state — name, phase, current slice, architecture file, and slice plan.

nodes.name: aliases.py
nodes.summary: Model alias registry mapping short names to (profile, model_id) pairs, loading built-in defaults from data/models.toml and merging user overrides from ~/.config/squadron/models.toml.
nodes.languageNotes: TypedDict with `total=False` splits required alias fields from optional metadata such as pricing and cost tier.

nodes.name: ModelPricing
nodes.summary: TypedDict describing per-token pricing (input, output, cache read/write) in USD per million tokens.

nodes.name: ModelAlias
nodes.summary: TypedDict for a model alias entry: required profile and model id plus optional cost tier, notes, and pricing metadata.

nodes.name: _extract_metadata
nodes.summary: Copies optional alias metadata (cost tier, notes, private flag) from a parsed TOML table onto the alias record, warning about unknown keys.

nodes.name: _extract_pricing
nodes.summary: Validates and normalizes the pricing sub-table of an alias definition into a ModelPricing entry.

nodes.name: _load_aliases_from_file
nodes.summary: Parses one models.toml file into a dict of alias name to ModelAlias, validating required profile/model fields and skipping malformed entries with warnings.

nodes.name: get_all_aliases
nodes.summary: Returns the merged alias registry with user-defined aliases overriding built-ins.

nodes.name: resolve_model_alias
nodes.summary: Resolves an alias name to its ModelAlias record; a pure dictionary lookup with no side effects, relied on by the classification pre-scan.

nodes.name: estimate_cost
nodes.summary: Computes an estimated USD cost for a call from an alias's pricing table and the input, output, and cached token counts.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting the public pipeline surface: data models, prompt-only renderer types, the model resolver, action/step enums, and the SDK session.

nodes.name: cf_op.py
nodes.summary: Pipeline action that delegates Context Forge operations (setting phase, slice, and related project state) to the ContextForgeClient.

nodes.name: CfOperation
nodes.summary: StrEnum of supported Context Forge operations the cf-op action may invoke.

nodes.name: CfOpAction
nodes.summary: Registered pipeline action that validates a cf-op step config and executes the requested Context Forge operation, mapping CLI failures onto ActionResult errors.

nodes.name: classification.py
nodes.summary: Planning-time pre-scan that walks a PipelineDefinition and classifies every model-dispatching step as SDK-required, non-SDK, or pool-uncertain without triggering pool selection side effects.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents an explicit side-effect-freeness contract, since classification must resolve models without mutating pool rotation state.

nodes.name: StepClass
nodes.summary: StrEnum of step classifications: SDK-required, non-SDK, or pool-uncertain.

nodes.name: PipelineShape
nodes.summary: StrEnum describing the overall execution shape a classified pipeline requires.

nodes.name: PoolClassificationPolicy
nodes.summary: Policy enum controlling how pool-backed steps are treated when their concrete model cannot be known at planning time.

nodes.name: StepClassification
nodes.summary: Result record for one classified step: resolved alias, model id, profile, classification, rationale, and container path.

nodes.name: PipelineClassification
nodes.summary: Aggregate classification for a whole pipeline, exposing whether a persistent SDK session or one-shot Claude dispatch is needed and the derived pipeline shape.

nodes.name: _review_template_model_fallback
nodes.summary: Derives the fallback model for a review step from its template when the step config does not name one explicitly.

nodes.name: _classify_alias_set
nodes.summary: Classifies a set of candidate aliases for one step, resolving each to a profile and deciding whether SDK execution is required.

nodes.name: _classify_pool_step
nodes.summary: Classifies a pool-backed step by inspecting the pool's static member aliases rather than performing a selection.

nodes.name: _classify_container_inner
nodes.summary: Recursively classifies steps nested inside container constructs (loops, each, fan-out), tracking the container path for each inner step.

nodes.name: classify_pipeline
nodes.summary: Entry point that walks every step of a pipeline definition and returns a PipelineClassification describing execution requirements.

nodes.name: compact_render.py
nodes.summary: Small shared helper for rendering compaction instruction templates with pipeline params, leaving unknown placeholders as literal text instead of raising.
nodes.languageNotes: Subclasses dict and overrides `__missing__` so str.format_map degrades gracefully instead of raising KeyError.

nodes.name: LenientDict
nodes.summary: Dict subclass that returns the placeholder text itself for missing keys, preventing KeyError during template formatting.

nodes.name: render_with_params
nodes.summary: Formats an instruction string against pipeline params using LenientDict so unresolved placeholders survive verbatim.

nodes.name: compaction_templates.py
nodes.summary: Single owner of compaction/summary template loading and rendering, reading YAML templates from the shipped data directory or the user's compaction directory.

nodes.name: CompactionTemplate
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding a parsed compaction template: name, description, instructions body, and optional suffix.

nodes.name: load_compaction_template
nodes.summary: Loads a named compaction template, preferring a user-supplied directory over the built-in data directory and raising when the template is missing.

nodes.name: _parse_template
nodes.summary: Parses one compaction template YAML file into a CompactionTemplate dataclass.

nodes.name: render_instructions
nodes.summary: Renders a compaction template's instruction body with keep/summarize directives and pipeline params substituted in.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Barrel exposing the model-pool public API — backends, loader functions, data models, the strategy protocol, and built-in strategies — from one import path.

nodes.name: backend.py
nodes.summary: Defines the PoolBackend interface used by ModelResolver and a default implementation that delegates to the pool loader module.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `typing.Protocol` with `@runtime_checkable` so alternative pool backends need no inheritance.

nodes.name: PoolBackend
nodes.summary: Protocol declaring the pool operations the resolver depends on: select, get_pool, list_pools, and reset_pool_state.

nodes.name: DefaultPoolBackend
nodes.summary: Default PoolBackend implementation forwarding every call to the module-level loader functions, duplicating no logic.

nodes.name: loader.py
nodes.summary: Loads and validates model pool definitions from built-in and user TOML files, persists round-robin rotation state, and performs pool selection via the strategy registry.
nodes.languageNotes: Reads with tomllib and writes state back with tomli_w, keeping rotation state durable across runs.

nodes.name: load_pool_state
nodes.summary: Reads persisted rotation state for a named pool from ~/.config/squadron/pool-state.toml, returning a fresh state when absent.

nodes.name: save_pool_state
nodes.summary: Writes a pool's rotation state back to the on-disk state file, creating the config directory when needed.

nodes.name: clear_pool_state
nodes.summary: Removes persisted rotation state for a pool so its next selection starts from the beginning.

nodes.name: _parse_pools_from_toml
nodes.summary: Parses a pools TOML document into ModelPool dataclasses, validating strategy names, member lists, and weights.

nodes.name: _validate_weights
nodes.summary: Checks that a weighted pool's weights align with its member models and are usable, raising PoolValidationError otherwise.

nodes.name: _validate_pool_aliases
nodes.summary: Verifies every model named by a pool exists in the alias registry, rejecting pools that reference unknown aliases.

nodes.name: load_builtin_pools
nodes.summary: Loads the pool definitions shipped in the package data directory.

nodes.name: load_user_pools
nodes.summary: Loads user-defined pools from ~/.config/squadron/pools.toml when present.

nodes.name: get_all_pools
nodes.summary: Returns the merged pool registry with user pools overriding built-ins.

nodes.name: get_pool
nodes.summary: Looks up a single pool by name, raising PoolNotFoundError when it is unknown.

nodes.name: select_from_pool
nodes.summary: Selects one alias from a pool by dispatching to its configured strategy and persisting any resulting rotation state.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Data models and exception types for the model-pool subsystem: pool definitions, selection context, rotation state, and selection records.

nodes.name: ModelPool
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass describing a named pool of model aliases with its selection strategy and optional weights.

nodes.name: PoolState
nodes.summary: Persistent rotation state for a pool, tracking the last index used by round-robin selection.

nodes.name: SelectionContext
nodes.summary: Metadata handed to a strategy's select() call: pool name, action type, run id, alias registry, prior state, and task description.

nodes.name: PoolSelection
nodes.summary: Record of one pool resolution event capturing the chosen alias, strategy, step, action type, and timestamp.

nodes.name: protocol.py
nodes.summary: Declares the PoolStrategy protocol that every built-in or user-registered pool selection strategy must satisfy.

nodes.name: PoolStrategy
nodes.summary: Runtime-checkable protocol whose select() returns the alias name chosen from a pool rather than a raw model id.

nodes.name: strategies.py
nodes.summary: Built-in pool selection strategies (random, round-robin, cheapest, weighted-random) plus the registry that maps strategy names to singleton instances.
nodes.languageNotes: A module-level name-to-instance registry keeps strategies pluggable without a switch statement.

nodes.name: PoolStrategy
nodes.summary: Local protocol restating the strategy interface so this module can type its implementations without a circular import.

nodes.name: RandomStrategy
nodes.summary: Selects a pool member uniformly at random.

nodes.name: RoundRobinStrategy
nodes.summary: Rotates deterministically through pool members using the persisted last-index state.

nodes.name: CheapestStrategy
nodes.summary: Picks the lowest-cost pool member by cost tier, breaking ties on input token pricing.

nodes.name: WeightedRandomStrategy
nodes.summary: Selects a pool member at random with probabilities proportional to configured weights.

nodes.name: register_strategy
nodes.summary: Registers a custom strategy instance under a name so pools can reference it.

nodes.name: get_strategy
nodes.summary: Looks up a strategy by name, raising StrategyNotFoundError when the name is unregistered.

nodes.name: prompt_renderer.py
nodes.summary: Core of --prompt-only mode: converts pipeline step configs into serializable instruction objects consumed by external callers such as the /sq:run slash command, without executing anything.
nodes.languageNotes: A per-action-type render function table keeps instruction building open to new action types without a growing conditional.

nodes.name: ActionInstruction
nodes.summary: Dataclass describing one rendered action: its instruction text, command, model and model-switch hints, template, and emit flag.

nodes.name: StepInstructions
nodes.summary: Dataclass bundling all rendered actions for one step along with run and step metadata, serializable to JSON.

nodes.name: CompletionResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass reporting terminal status, message, and run id when a prompt-only run finishes.

nodes.name: _render_cf_op
nodes.summary: Renders a cf-op step into an instruction describing the Context Forge command to run.

nodes.name: _render_dispatch
nodes.summary: Renders a dispatch step into an agent-dispatch instruction with the resolved model and prompt arguments.

nodes.name: _render_review
nodes.summary: Renders a review step into a review instruction carrying the template, target, resolved model, and verbosity.

nodes.name: _render_checkpoint
nodes.summary: Renders a checkpoint step into an instruction that pauses for an accept/reject decision.

nodes.name: _render_commit
nodes.summary: Renders a commit step into a git commit instruction with the configured message.

nodes.name: _render_summary
nodes.summary: Renders a summary step by loading the named compaction template and substituting pipeline params into its instructions.

nodes.name: _render_devlog
nodes.summary: Renders a devlog step into an instruction to append a development log entry.

nodes.name: _render_compact
nodes.summary: Renders a compact step into a context-compaction instruction.

nodes.name: _build_action_instruction
nodes.summary: Dispatches one action config to the matching render function and returns the resulting ActionInstruction.

nodes.name: render_step_instructions
nodes.summary: Public entry point that renders every action of a step into a StepInstructions object with run and position metadata.

nodes.name: resolver.py
nodes.summary: ModelResolver implementing the five-level model selection cascade (CLI override, action, step, pipeline, config default) with transparent handling of `pool:` references.

nodes.name: ModelResolver
nodes.summary: Resolves the model for a step by walking the priority cascade, expanding pool references through the configured PoolBackend and firing the on_pool_selection callback.

nodes.name: ModelResolutionError
nodes.summary: Raised when no cascade level yields a usable model for a step.

nodes.name: summary_render.py
nodes.summary: Helpers for the summary/compaction CLI path: loads a template by name, gathers Context Forge project params best-effort, and renders the instruction text.

nodes.name: resolve_template_instructions
nodes.summary: Loads a compaction template by name and returns its instructions rendered against gathered Context Forge params.

nodes.name: resolve_template_suffix
nodes.summary: Returns a compaction template's rendered suffix text, if the template defines one.

nodes.name: gather_cf_params
nodes.summary: Best-effort collection of Context Forge project parameters (project, phase, slice) for template substitution, tolerating an absent or failing cf CLI.

nodes.name: profiles.py
nodes.summary: Provider profile definitions — built-in profiles plus user overrides loaded from providers.toml — describing base URL, auth type, and API key env var per LLM provider.

nodes.name: ProviderProfile
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass describing one provider profile: name, provider type, base URL, API key env var, default headers, and auth type.

nodes.name: load_user_profiles
nodes.summary: Parses ~/.config/squadron/providers.toml into ProviderProfile objects, validating required fields and reporting malformed entries.

nodes.name: get_all_profiles
nodes.summary: Returns built-in profiles merged with user-defined overrides.

nodes.name: get_profile
nodes.summary: Looks up a provider profile by name from the merged registry.

nodes.name: is_sdk_profile
nodes.summary: Reports whether a profile routes through an SDK-based provider, which determines whether a persistent session is required.

nodes.name: installer.py
nodes.summary: Installs a skill pack by resolving its source (bundled, local path, or GitHub clone) and copying the pack's markdown command files into the target commands directory. Writes an install receipt afterward so uninstall can remove the exact files it placed.
nodes.languageNotes: Receipt-write failures log a WARNING rather than failing the install, since the files are already on disk by that point.

nodes.name: manifest.py
nodes.summary: Loads and layers skills.toml manifests, merging the shipped default with the user-level (~/.config/squadron) and project-level (.squadron) manifests into one effective pack list.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses importlib.resources.files to read the package-shipped default manifest, so it works from a wheel as well as a source checkout.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Defines the data contract for the skills subsystem: pack manifest entries, install results, persisted install receipts, the surface-type enum, and the shared source-resolution error.
nodes.languageNotes: Mixes Pydantic BaseModel (for validated, serialized types) with a plain dataclass for the transient InstallResult; a model_validator enforces the exactly-one-surface rule.

nodes.name: receipts.py
nodes.summary: Persists and reads install receipts as TOML files, giving uninstall an exact record of which files each pack wrote and where.

nodes.name: resolver.py
nodes.summary: Resolves a pack entry's source string to a directory on disk, handling bundled package resources, absolute paths, user-config-relative paths, and shallow git clones of github: sources.
nodes.languageNotes: clone_github is a context manager wrapping tempfile.TemporaryDirectory plus a subprocess git clone, so the checkout is cleaned up deterministically.

nodes.name: install_pack
nodes.summary: Public entry point that resolves a pack's source, copies its command files into place, and records an install receipt.

nodes.name: _write_install_receipt
nodes.summary: Builds an InstallReceipt from the entry and install result and writes it, downgrading write failures to a logged warning.

nodes.name: _install_prefix
nodes.summary: Copies every markdown file from the resolved source into a prefix-named subdirectory of the commands directory.

nodes.name: _install_dispatch
nodes.summary: Copies a single dispatch markdown file into the sq commands directory, erroring if the named file is missing at the source.

nodes.name: SkillsManifest
nodes.summary: Pydantic model holding a manifest's pack entries keyed by pack name plus an origin string identifying where the manifest came from.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Parses a skills.toml file into a validated SkillsManifest, raising ValueError on malformed TOML or invalid pack entries.

nodes.name: merge
nodes.summary: Overlays a project manifest's packs onto a user manifest's packs, letting the more specific layer win.

nodes.name: _load_shipped_default
nodes.summary: Reads the skills.toml bundled inside the squadron package and returns it as the baseline manifest layer.

nodes.name: load_effective
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective manifest by layering the shipped default, the user manifest, and the project manifest in precedence order.

nodes.name: SurfaceType
nodes.summary: String enum naming the two ways a pack can expose commands: a prefix directory or a single dispatch file.

nodes.name: PackEntry
nodes.summary: Manifest entry for one skill pack, carrying its source string and validating that exactly one of prefix or dispatch_file is set.

nodes.name: InstallResult
nodes.summary: Transient dataclass reporting which files an install wrote and the destination directory they landed in.

nodes.name: InstallReceipt
nodes.summary: Persisted record of an install — pack name, surface type, destination, and file list — consulted by uninstall to remove exactly what was written.

nodes.name: SkillSourceError
nodes.summary: Exception raised when a skill pack source cannot be resolved or fetched.

nodes.name: write_receipt
nodes.summary: Serializes an InstallReceipt to a TOML file under the receipts directory, creating the directory if needed.

nodes.name: read_receipt
nodes.summary: Loads a pack's install receipt from TOML and validates it back into an InstallReceipt, returning None when no receipt exists.

nodes.name: resolve_source
nodes.summary: Dispatches a pack entry's source string to the right resolution strategy — bundled resource, absolute path, or path relative to the user config directory.

nodes.name: clone_github
nodes.summary: Context manager that shallow-clones a github: source into a temporary directory and cleans it up on exit, raising SkillSourceError when git is unavailable or the clone fails.

nodes.name: _resolve_bundled
nodes.summary: Locates a pack directory shipped inside the squadron package using importlib.resources, checking the candidate locations before erroring.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel for the fan-in subsystem, re-exporting the FanInReducer protocol and the get_reducer registry lookup as the package's public surface.
nodes.languageNotes: Python package barrel using explicit __all__ to pin the public API.

nodes.name: protocol.py
nodes.summary: Defines the FanInReducer structural protocol that merges parallel fan-out branch results into a single ActionResult.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses typing.Protocol with @runtime_checkable plus TYPE_CHECKING-only imports to avoid runtime import cycles with the executor and models modules.

nodes.name: reducers.py
nodes.summary: Built-in FanInReducer implementations plus the module-level reducer registry and its get_reducer lookup, registering the 'collect' and 'first_pass' strategies at import time.
nodes.languageNotes: Registry populated at module import time; ActionResult is imported lazily inside methods to keep the module free of circular dependencies.

nodes.name: fan_out.py
nodes.summary: Implements the fan_out step type, which dispatches N parallel model branches and reduces them via a named FanInReducer, and registers itself in the step-type registry on import.

nodes.name: FanInReducer
nodes.summary: Runtime-checkable protocol declaring a single reduce() method that folds a list of branch StepResults into one ActionResult.

nodes.name: get_reducer
nodes.summary: Looks up a reducer by name in the module-level registry, raising KeyError with the list of registered names when the name is unknown.

nodes.name: CollectReducer
nodes.summary: Reducer that gathers every branch's step name, status, and action results into outputs['branches'], reporting success only when all branches completed.

nodes.name: FirstPassReducer
nodes.summary: Reducer that returns the ActionResult of the first branch producing a PASS verdict, falling back to the last branch's first result when no branch passes.

nodes.name: FanOutStepType
nodes.summary: Step type for concurrent multi-model branch dispatch; validates the models, inner, n, and fan_in configuration keys and yields an aggregate inner step while leaving execution to the pipeline executor.
nodes.languageNotes: expand() deliberately returns an empty list because the executor handles fan_out directly, mirroring the 'each' step pattern.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Package manifest for `squadron-ai` declaring runtime dependencies (Pydantic, Anthropic SDK, Claude Agent SDK, FastAPI, Typer, MCP, OpenAI, Google ADK), the `sq`/`squadron` console entry points bound to `squadron.cli.app:app`, and the hatchling wheel build that force-includes the `commands` directory. Also centralizes tooling config for ruff, pytest (asyncio auto mode), and pyright strict type checking over `src`.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-file PEP 621 manifest that doubles as the tool config hub: `[tool.ruff]`, `[tool.pytest.ini_options]`, and `[tool.pyright]` live alongside project metadata, so linting, testing, and type-checking settings change in exactly one place.

nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Template for the local `.env` file documenting all ten `ORCH_`-prefixed runtime settings: agent type and provider defaults, the default model identifier, Anthropic credentials (API key, bearer token, base URL override for proxy/gateway setups), logging level and format, and the REST/WebSocket server host and port.
nodes.languageNotes: The uniform `ORCH_` prefix maps directly to a pydantic-settings `env_prefix`, so each documented key resolves to a settings field without per-variable wiring. Credential slots are deliberately left empty so the example never carries a real secret.

nodes.name: .gitleaks.toml
nodes.summary: Gitleaks secret-scanning configuration that extends the default rule set and adds a narrow allowlist for known fake credentials — placeholder API keys and empty `*_API_KEY=""` assignments — plus path exemptions for the `tests/` tree and one slice document.

nodes.name: .context-forge.toml
nodes.summary: Minimal Context Forge project configuration holding a single workflow setting, `review_gate_effective_date`, which marks the cutoff date from which review gating applies to project artifacts.

nodes.name: default.yaml
nodes.summary: Built-in default compaction policy defining the context-compression instructions sent to the LLM, with {keep_section} and {summarize_section} placeholders plus general rules for preserving decisions, rationale, error resolutions, and file references.
nodes.languageNotes: YAML block scalar (|) holds the instruction body; Python str.format-style placeholders are substituted by render_instructions().

nodes.name: minimal-sdk.yaml
nodes.summary: Compaction policy for SDK session rotation: instructs the model to emit a standalone third-person summary of the prior conversation for injection into a fresh session, and adds a verbatim suffix telling the restored session to wait for direction before acting.
nodes.languageNotes: Only template in the set that defines a `suffix` key, appended verbatim after the generated summary rather than being sent through the LLM.

nodes.name: minimal.yaml
nodes.summary: Lean compaction policy that retains only the current slice's design, task breakdown, implementation summaries, and related architectural discussion, discarding everything else.

nodes.name: models.toml
nodes.summary: Packaged registry of ~40 built-in model aliases mapping short names (opus, gpt54, gemini, kimi25, glm5) to a provider profile, full model identifier, cost tier, privacy flag, and optional per-1M-token pricing sub-table. Ships as the default layer that user aliases in ~/.config/squadron/models.toml extend or override.
nodes.languageNotes: TOML nested tables: each [aliases.<name>] entry may carry an [aliases.<name>.pricing] sub-table, so the loader must handle a heterogeneous shape where subscription-tier models simply omit pricing rather than defaulting it to zero.

nodes.name: pools.toml
nodes.summary: Defines the three built-in model pools (review, high, cheap), each with a description, a selection strategy (round-robin, random, cheapest, weighted-random), and a member list of alias names drawn from models.toml. Used to spread pipeline and review work across multiple models.
nodes.languageNotes: Pool members are alias names, not full model identifiers — the pool layer resolves through the alias registry, keeping provider details in exactly one place.

nodes.name: skills.toml
nodes.summary: Default skill pack manifest shipped inside the squadron package, declaring the bundled 'analysis' pack with its source and command prefix. User- and project-level skills.toml files layer on top of these entries.

nodes.name: P1.yaml
nodes.summary: Phase-1 pipeline that runs project vision-and-scope design with an Opus model, gates it behind an `arch` review on glm5, always pauses for a human checkpoint, then emits a minimal-sdk summary to stdout, clipboard, and file.

nodes.name: P2.yaml
nodes.summary: Phase-2 pipeline for architectural initiative design: an Opus design step reviewed by the `arch` template on glm5, followed by a minimal-sdk summary emitted to stdout, clipboard, and file.

nodes.name: P4.yaml
nodes.summary: Phase-4 slice-design pipeline with parameterized `{model}` and `{review-model}`; runs the design step, reviews it with the `slice` template, checkpoints only on failure, and emits a summary.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `{param}` interpolation so model choices are caller-overridable at run time.

nodes.name: P5.yaml
nodes.summary: Phase-5 pipeline that breaks a slice into tasks using the configured model, reviews the breakdown with the `tasks` template, checkpoints on failure, and emits a minimal-sdk summary.

nodes.name: P6.yaml
nodes.summary: Phase-6 implementation pipeline: runs the implement step, reviews the diff with the `code` template, checkpoints on failure, emits a summary, and appends an automatic devlog entry.

nodes.name: app.yaml
nodes.summary: Work-in-progress whole-application pipeline chaining phases 1-3 design with always-on checkpoints, a summarize/compact/restore rotation, and an `each` fan-out that runs phase-4 design for every unfinished slice in a plan.
nodes.languageNotes: Demonstrates the summarize -> compact -> restore compose pattern for surviving session rotation.

nodes.name: compose-gate-example.yaml
nodes.summary: Reference pipeline that runs a judge review and a standard slice review as separate named steps, then composes both verdicts in a single `gate` step using the most-severe policy with an on-concerns checkpoint.
nodes.languageNotes: Named steps (`name:`) let the gate reference upstream verdicts via `judge_from` / `review_from`.

nodes.name: design-batch.yaml
nodes.summary: Batch pipeline that iterates `cf.unfinished_slices(plan)` and runs a phase-4 design with a `slice` review for each item, never stopping for a human checkpoint.

nodes.name: example.yaml
nodes.summary: Annotated reference pipeline documenting every available step type, checkpoint trigger, emit destination, and loop option; its live steps run design, tasks, a compact, and a second design.
nodes.languageNotes: Most step forms are commented out on purpose - the file doubles as the user-facing pipeline DSL reference.

nodes.name: findings-addressed-cycle.yaml
nodes.summary: Bounded fix-review loop that commits each iteration, runs a blind fresh review, and exits only when a `findings-addressed` gate confirms the prior round's findings were resolved, escalating to a judge model for undecidable findings.
nodes.languageNotes: `commit_each_iteration: true` is mandatory here - the findings-addressed policy needs per-round commits as evidence.

nodes.name: implement.yaml
nodes.summary: Minimal implementation pipeline for slices whose design and tasks already exist: runs the phase-6 implement step with a `code` review, checkpoints on failure, and writes a devlog entry.

nodes.name: judge-cycle.yaml
nodes.summary: Judge-gated dispatch/review loop bounded at three iterations that exits on a passing review and escalates to a human checkpoint when the iteration budget is exhausted.

nodes.name: review.yaml
nodes.summary: Single-step pipeline that runs a standalone `code` review against existing artifacts and pauses for a human whenever the verdict is CONCERNS or worse.

nodes.name: slice.yaml
nodes.summary: Full slice lifecycle pipeline running phase-4 design, phase-5 tasks, and phase-6 implementation, each with its own review template and checkpoint policy, interleaved with summarize/compact/restore rotations and a closing devlog.
nodes.languageNotes: Repeats the summary(emit) -> compact -> summary(restore) triple so long runs survive context rotation without losing prior work.

nodes.name: tasks.yaml
nodes.summary: Task-through-implementation pipeline that runs phase-5 task breakdown with a `tasks` review, rotates context, then runs phase-6 implementation with a `code` review and a final devlog entry.

nodes.name: test-compact-compose.yaml
nodes.summary: Integration-test pipeline verifying that summarize, compact, and restore are independent and compose correctly, by dispatching a prompt, rotating the session, and asking the model to recall the earlier facts.

nodes.name: test-fanout.yaml
nodes.summary: Test pipeline exercising the `fan_out` step by dispatching the same inner prompt across the minimax and glm5 models and collecting the branch results.

nodes.name: test-loop.yaml
nodes.summary: Test pipeline exercising the `loop` step: up to three dispatch-then-review iterations that exit on a passing review and fail outright when the budget is exhausted.

nodes.name: test-p4.yaml
nodes.summary: Test variant of the phase-4 slice-design pipeline that defaults to the kimi25 model and omits the checkpoint, used to exercise P4 behaviour without human gating.

nodes.name: test-pipeline.yaml
nodes.summary: Test pipeline chaining phase-4 design and phase-5 tasks with haiku, then a rotate-emitting summary and a second design step to verify the rotated session still remembers the prior design.

nodes.name: arch.yaml
nodes.summary: Packaged review template `arch` that evaluates an architecture document on its own merits for internal consistency, completeness, feasibility, technology fitness, and antipatterns. Carries a ~105-line system prompt, read-only tool grant (Read/Glob/Grep), opus model, and an inline prompt_template rendered from the required `input` document.
nodes.languageNotes: YAML block scalars (`|`) carry the multi-line system prompt and prompt template; `{input}` / `{cwd}` placeholders are substituted from the declared `inputs` contract.

nodes.name: code.yaml
nodes.summary: Packaged review template `code` that reviews source changes against project conventions and rules, scoped by optional `files` glob or `diff` git ref. Unique among the shipped templates in delegating prompt construction to a Python builder (`squadron.review.builders.code.code_review_prompt`) and in declaring `diff_exclude_patterns` that strip non-source files from the git diff.
nodes.languageNotes: `prompt_builder` holds a dotted import path resolved to a callable at load time; it is mutually exclusive with the `prompt_template` block scalar used by every other template.

nodes.name: judge-findings-addressed.yaml
nodes.summary: Judge template `judge.findings-addressed` that assigns a per-finding status to the unsettled CONCERN+ residue of a findings-addressed gate. Takes prior findings, the round diff, and a fresh reviewer's findings, and is constrained to emit only `<finding-id>: <status>` lines — no summary, verdict, or findings section.
nodes.languageNotes: `setting_sources: null` deliberately isolates the judge from project settings so its scoring is not colored by repo conventions.

nodes.name: judge-slice-vs-arch.yaml
nodes.summary: Judge template `judge.slice-vs-arch` that scores a slice design against its parent architecture/HLD, emitting per-criterion rationale, a numeric score, a criteria map, and findings. Declares a `judge:` block with `pass_floor: 82` and `concerns_floor: 60` that the pipeline judge action turns into a verdict.
nodes.languageNotes: The `judge:` block supplies numeric thresholds consumed downstream; the template itself never emits a verdict line, keeping scoring and verdict derivation separate.

nodes.name: judge-tasks-vs-slice.yaml
nodes.summary: Judge template `judge.tasks-vs-slice` that scores a task breakdown against its parent slice design, cross-referencing success criteria to surface gaps, scope creep, sequencing issues, and mis-sized tasks. Declares `pass_floor: 78` and `concerns_floor: 55` in its `judge:` block.

nodes.name: slice.yaml
nodes.summary: Packaged review template `slice` that evaluates a slice design document for architectural alignment against a supplied `against` architecture/HLD. The narrative counterpart to judge-slice-vs-arch: it reports severity-tagged findings rather than a numeric score.

nodes.name: tasks.yaml

nodes.summary: Writes the frontmatter pre-commit hook into the repository's hooks directory, marks it executable, and points git's core.hooksPath at it — the gate installing itself.

nodes.name: installer_for
nodes.summary: Looks up the installer callable registered for a given doctor check name, returning None when the check has no automated remediation.

nodes.name: run_install
nodes.summary: Executes the installer registered for a check name, logging and converting unexpected exceptions into a failed InstallOutcome so the setup loop never crashes on remediation.

nodes.name: setup_steps.py
nodes.summary: Pure, I/O-free conversion layer translating doctor CheckResult values into ordered SetupStep records for `sq setup`, including step classification, human-readable titles, and per-profile recheck closures.
nodes.languageNotes: StrEnum plus frozen dataclass define the step contract; recheck behavior is supplied as closures so this module stays free of I/O.

nodes.name: StepKind
nodes.summary: String enum enumerating the four setup step outcomes — already-done, install, configure, and optional — used to drive icons, colors, and interactive behavior.

nodes.name: SetupStep
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass describing one setup step: its title, kind, section, detail text, optional fix command, and optional recheck callable.

nodes.name: _recheck_git_hooks
nodes.summary: Re-runs the git hooks doctor check and reports whether the pre-commit gate is now satisfied after an install attempt.

nodes.name: _classify
nodes.summary: Maps a doctor CheckResult status and its section to the corresponding StepKind, deciding whether a failure is blocking or merely optional.

nodes.name: _make_profile_recheck
nodes.summary: Builds a closure that rechecks whether credentials for a named provider profile are now present, so a provider step can be re-evaluated in place.

nodes.name: _human_title
nodes.summary: Converts a raw doctor check name into a readable step title suitable for display in the setup walkthrough.

nodes.name: build_steps
nodes.summary: Converts the full list of doctor check results into an ordered SetupStep list, attaching fix commands, recheck callables, and profile-specific handling for the selected provider profile.

nodes.name: shutdown.py
nodes.summary: Implements the `sq shutdown` command, gracefully stopping a single named agent or every running agent through the daemon HTTP client, with explicit errors when the daemon is down or the agent is unknown.
nodes.languageNotes: Synchronous Typer entry point wraps asyncio.run over async daemon calls, keeping the CLI surface blocking.

nodes.name: shutdown
nodes.summary: Typer entry point for `sq shutdown`. Validates that exactly one of an agent name or --all was supplied and dispatches to the matching async routine.

nodes.name: _shutdown_one
nodes.summary: Asks the daemon to shut down one named agent, translating daemon-not-running and agent-not-found failures into actionable CLI errors.

nodes.name: _shutdown_all
nodes.summary: Shuts down every registered agent through the daemon and reports how many were stopped.

nodes.name: skills.py
nodes.summary: Defines the `sq skills` Typer sub-app with install, uninstall, and list sub-commands for managing skill packs declared in user and project skills.toml manifests, using install receipts to track what was written.
nodes.languageNotes: A nested typer.Typer instance registers sub-commands, so the module exports a sub-app rather than individual command callbacks.

nodes.name: install
nodes.summary: Implements `sq skills install`: resolves the pack from the effective manifest, installs its commands into the target directory, and writes an install receipt.

nodes.name: uninstall
nodes.summary: Implements `sq skills uninstall`: reads the pack's install receipt and removes exactly the files it recorded, refusing to guess when no receipt exists.

nodes.name: list_packs
nodes.summary: Implements `sq skills list`, rendering a Rich table of every pack in the effective manifest with its surface type, origin, and installed state.

nodes.name: _detect_origin
nodes.summary: Determines whether a pack came from the project manifest, the user manifest, or the shipped defaults, for display in the pack listing.

nodes.name: spawn.py
nodes.summary: Implements the `sq spawn` command, creating a named agent through the daemon by assembling a request from CLI flags, the resolved provider profile, and configured defaults.
nodes.languageNotes: Precedence is explicit at each layer — CLI flag, then profile field, then config — instead of silent fallbacks.

nodes.name: _resolve_profile
nodes.summary: Loads a named provider profile and returns the request fields it contributes (provider, base URL, credentials), letting explicit CLI flags override profile values.

nodes.name: spawn
nodes.summary: Typer entry point for `sq spawn`. Collects agent name, type, provider, working directory, system prompt, permission mode, and model into a request payload and hands it to the daemon.

nodes.name: _spawn
nodes.summary: Posts the assembled spawn request to the daemon, reporting success or converting a missing daemon into an actionable CLI error.

nodes.name: summary_instructions.py
nodes.summary: Implements the hidden `sq summary-instructions` command used by the `/sq:summary` slash command, printing deterministic template-driven compaction instructions to stdout and supporting suffix, project-parameter, and saved-summary restore modes.
nodes.languageNotes: All options are declared hidden=True so the command stays out of `sq --help` while remaining callable by the slash command.

nodes.name: summary_instructions
nodes.summary: Typer entry point that dispatches to project-parameter emission, restore, suffix, or full instruction rendering depending on the flags supplied.

nodes.name: _handle_project
nodes.summary: Gathers Context Forge project parameters for the given working directory and prints them for the slash command to consume.

nodes.name: _handle_restore
nodes.summary: Locates a previously saved summary file for the current project — by explicit key or most recent — and prints its contents for session restoration.

nodes.name: _select_summary
nodes.summary: Chooses which saved summary file to restore from the candidate matches, preferring an exact key match and otherwise the newest entry for the project.

nodes.name: summary_run.py
nodes.summary: Implements the hidden `sq summary-run` command, executing a one-shot compaction summary through a non-SDK provider profile and printing the result to stdout for prompt-only pipeline rendering.

nodes.name: summary_run
nodes.summary: Parses repeatable key=value parameters, renders the named compaction template's instructions, and runs the summary against the given provider profile and model, printing the captured text.

nodes.name: task.py
nodes.summary: Implements the `sq task` command, sending a prompt to a named running agent through the daemon and rendering the returned messages, including truncated tool-use previews.

nodes.name: task
nodes.summary: Typer entry point for `sq task` that forwards the agent name and prompt into the async send-and-display routine.

nodes.name: _task
nodes.summary: Sends the prompt to the named agent via the daemon client and displays the reply, converting daemon-down and unknown-agent conditions into actionable CLI errors.

nodes.name: _display_messages
nodes.summary: Renders the agent's returned messages, labelling each when several were returned and truncating tool-use payloads to a fixed preview length.
